headline: Since Monday's 18:00 brief: 115 releases (v0.1.868 to v0.1.983). /contribute/ went live at 21:40 and passed security@. THE BIG STOP at 23:30 paused every agent; THE RESTART at 02:40 turned pt.news into the agentic edition. The two interviews (Buzz Messaging AI, Student Property Network) are live on the home page, the agentic edition leads the front page, and the design flip is decided (B, round 3). But dev@ and dev.pages@ have been off for five hours: conductor.b@ will restart them only on Dinis's word in its own session on account B. Until then nothing from the restart is built.
